title: The Fastest Possible Kuldra Raid With Boss Skips
author: DoubleohDerek
description:
⚡ THE FASTEST WAY THROUGH THE KULDRA RAID! 🐉 | RuneScape: Dragonwilds

Want to clear the Kuldra Raid as FAST as possible? 🔥 You're in the right place!

In this video, we're taking on the Kuldra Raid in RuneScape: Dragonwilds and showing you the fastest route, useful shortcuts, and ways to cut down wasted time so you can get through the raid more efficiently! ⚔️

💨 WHAT YOU'LL SEE IN THIS GUIDE:
✅ The fastest way through the Kuldra Raid
✅ Shortcuts to save valuable time
✅ Route tips to keep you moving
✅ Tips to make your raid runs smoother and more efficient
✅ Epic boss encounters and chaotic Dragonwilds action!

Whether you're looking to speed up your runs, get back into the action faster, or just want a more efficient way to tackle Kuldra, this guide is for you!

I love exploring, building, magic, and surviving in open-world games, especially when I'm playing alongside friends! If you're into gaming adventures, epic boss fights, and discovering smarter ways to play, you're in the right place.

comments.text:
Great video, you've made one section easier for me!

For the last section with the guardians, if you keep to the right wall in their room only the right/ranged guardian aggros. Also you don't need to activate the moving platforms after the guardians, you can just windstep off the pipe on the wall where the platforms come out! :)

comments.author: @eChuckNorris
comments.text:
This isn't the fastest way by a long margin :) you're missing at least 3 skips.
After the Garou Thane guarding the door there's a hole at the back corner you can get through, it's 2 jumps from there to abby demon, saves 1 minute.
The area with the other Thanes/giant rats with the air/fire/earth puzzle there's a skip behind the castle that bypasses the whole area saving 2 mins.
The last major skip is after the keep jump area on the pipes. There's an area you can jump through that gets you under the map to activate the last teleporter, saves another minute or so.
